name: Konkyo
tagline: A research library whose agents answer only from your sources, and prove every quote.

track.title: The Agent That Can Explain Why
track.statement: Build agents that investigate complex questions across multiple data sources, connect findings, and produce evidence-backed answers or recommendations.

users: Students and researchers who read many sources and must cite them: thesis students, course takers with lecture recordings and slides, reading groups comparing papers.
problem: Chat assistants answer fluently from memory, mix up sources and invent quotes; checking them takes as long as reading. Konkyo answers only from the person's library, refuses when it can't, and makes every claim checkable at the passage.

entryPoints.http: POST /api/v1/ask (Authorization: Bearer <key from Settings → API keys>)

sampleMode.needs: Node 22.18+ and pnpm; no keys, no services
sampleMode.how: Replays the recorded replies of OpenAI, Zetaris, the library search and H-MEM recall (examples/*/tape.jsonl) while every step of Konkyo's own logic runs again: planning, citation parsing, quote checks, Verifier verdicts and rewrites, the matrix, the World Model and a new trace in logs/. Unrecorded questions are refused.

examples.shows: A cited answer across the papers; every quote found in Zetaris
The Analyst's agree/disagree matrix, checked in Zetaris and kept in the World Model
A false premise corrected from the source
A textbook and a lecture transcript together; the Verifier sends a sentence back and it is rewritten
Not in the library: Konkyo says so instead of answering

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Stand-alone question, 1-3 searches, comparison flag; reads H-MEM corrections first

agents.name: Retriever
agents.role: Hybrid search (pgvector + Postgres full text, Reciprocal Rank Fusion)

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: Cited draft, one finding per sentence, exact quotes; rewrites rejected sentences

agents.name: Verifier
agents.role: Code check of each quote, one Zetaris statement for all quotes, support judgement; sends failures back (max 2 rounds), drops what still fails

agents.name: Analyst
agents.role: Claims × sources with stances, quotes checked in Zetaris, recorded in the World Model

agents.name: Scout
agents.role: Deep search over OpenAlex and the web, screened in Markovian steps

agents.name: Tutor
agents.role: Practice items with Verifier-checked answer keys and Zetaris-checked quotes

zetaris.role: The evidence store every quote is checked against; nothing is marked verified without it.

where.use: Evidence store: passages as a FILESTORE JSON table and Zetaris's own PDFBox reading of each PDF rendition; a file is Ready only after Zetaris answers for it
Pre-check that retrieved documents are in the evidence store
Every quote of an answer verified in one Spark SQL statement (VALUES joined to Zetaris's PDF text or stored transcripts); also for the matrix, study items, lecture notes and audio briefs
Topic watches as Lightning REST tables over OpenAlex, new papers found with one LEFT ANTI JOIN

evidence: Trace action queried_zetaris with sqlHash and rowsReturned
The receipt's Show SQL in the app

engines.use: Per-person corrections memory from 👎 reasons, wrong passages and wrong study items; read by the Planner before every answer; ratings adjust confidence
The Analyst's sources, claims and supports/contradicts/qualifies relations with passage provenance, one event-sourced model per person
Deep search screening in bounded RESEARCH steps carrying only the shortlist; its token estimate shown and logged

otherServices.ElevenLabs: Scribe transcription with word timing; Text-to-Dialogue audio briefs; study sounds
otherServices.OpenAlex: Paper metadata, open-access PDFs, topic watches
otherServices.Composio: Gmail, Google Drive and Notion connectors
otherServices.Gotenberg: Word, PowerPoint and web pages to PDF renditions
